geopolitics_summary: US-Russia sanctions bill and Ukraine winter energy attacks risk; Hungary nuclear outage amid drought; Hormuz shipping route uncertainty pressures crude supply into EU.

themes.headline: Germany gas reserves low, risks winter shortages and higher EU prices
themes.why_it_matters: Low German storage ahead of winter directly lifts TTF forward curve. Undersupply forces fuel-switching to power; higher gas marginal cost pushes EU day-ahead power spreads wider.

themes.headline: Hungary loses 40% power generation as Paks nuclear shut by drought
themes.why_it_matters: Paks shutdown removes ~2 GW from Central EU grid; drought-driven outage lifts regional power prices and increases import demand from neighbors, supporting DA and Cal+1 spreads across CEE.

themes.headline: Ukraine prepares for winter energy attacks on infrastructure, target refineries
themes.why_it_matters: Ukrainian attacks on Russian refinery capacity constrain crude supply; winter energy attacks threaten regional power/gas transit. Risk premium embeds into European calendar spreads and winter contract volatility.

themes.headline: US Senate passes Russia sanctions bill; House battle looms in September
themes.why_it_matters: Escalating US Russia sanctions could restrict LNG export licenses and Russian LNG flows; tightens global LNG balance and raises TTF via reduced supply and costlier US-to-EU arbitrage.

themes.headline: Iran-Oman finalize Strait of Hormuz shipping deal as geopolitical tension eases
themes.why_it_matters: Hormuz reopening reduces crude supply risk premium; lower oil prices ease fuel-switch economics and reduce European power generation costs via lower fuel oil and gasoil marginal rates.

watchlist: US House vote on Russia sanctions bill (September) – LNG license impact
Hungary Paks restart timeline – tracks drought recovery and regional supply
Winter 2026–27 gas storage fill rate in Germany and Northwest Europe through September
France 2027 blackout drill protocols – regulatory changes to market design or reserve rules
